text:
emily_finance: Customer Vertex Labs disputed a Dedicated overage on INV-2025-1122. They say the spike was unexpected and ask for an SLA credit.

jordan_billing: Invoice shows Dedicated commit $8,500 and an overage line $890 dated 2025-05-09. No SLA credit applied.

tess_eng: I checked traces: short-lived routing anomaly at 2025-05-09T14:22:10Z rerouted ~40s of traffic to dedicated due to a transient DNS flake in control plane. A retry flood from the client amplified token usage. Request IDs: r_a11, r_a12, r_a13.

emily_finance: If root cause is our control plane DNS issue that's on us. Can we credit full $890? Need incident link for audit.

jordan_billing: Proposed adjust ADJ-9503 for $890 with reason code DED-CONTROLPLANE-FAULT. Will wait for eng confirm + finance approval.

mark_accounting: For the journal, I'll need the incident ID and approval note.

tess_eng: Filed infra incident INF-3055 with timeline and fix (DNS retry backoff change). Confirming cause = provider fault.

emily_finance: Approved full credit. Jordan, proceed and include INF-3055 in memo. Also add a short note to billing runbook to auto-flag usage windows that align with control-plane incidents.

jordan_billing: Will create ADJ-9503 and BIL ticket. billing-bot: please create ticket for audit.

billing-bot: Ticket BIL-4525 created: "ADJ-9503 for INV-2025-1122 (DED-CONTROLPLANE-FAULT)". Audit trail started.

emily_finance: Thanks all. Notify Vertex Labs via CS with the credit reference and timeline.
